verdict.rationale: HubSpot has a public REST API, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question, but the evidence pack shows none: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The markdown docs and llms.txt index are documentation, and the MCP server belongs to a different story; neither is a machine-readable API spec, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
